verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an analytics platform and its CLI, wizard, MCP server, and self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, either for PostHog's own tooling or an SDK opt-out control. The free MIT self-host option (posthog-docs-14) is adjacent and does not show that telemetry can be disabled, so it earns no credit.
